chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Our father narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu al-Jarood, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, who said:

I entered upon Fatima (peace be upon her), and in front of her was a tablet upon which were the names of the Trustees (al-Awsiyaa'). I counted twelve, the last of whom is the Qa'im (peace be upon him). Three of them were Muhammad, and four of them were Ali (peace be upon them).

key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: The Trustees or Successors, referring specifically to the Imams
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Riser, a title for the twelfth Imam, al-Mahdi
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fatima bint Muhammad (peace be upon her), the daughter of the Prophet
key_terms.لَوْحٌ: A tablet or board, used here to record the names of the Imams

ai.seo_question: What are the names of the twelve Trustees listed on the tablet seen by Jabir ibn Abdullah in the presence of Fatima?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights a unique physical sign (ayah) in Fatima al-Zahra’s possession, listing the twelve Trustees (Awsiyaa') with specific repetitions of the names Muhammad and Ali, culminating in the Qa'im. It serves as a crucial proof for the Imamate’s divine designation (Nass) and the exact number of Imams, reinforcing the continuity of leadership from the Prophet’s household to the twelfth Imam.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-7 Al-Hussein ibn Ahmad ibn Idris - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his father quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Ibrahim ibn Hashem, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Mahboob, on the authority of Abil Jarood, on the authority of Abi Ja’far (s), on the authority of Jabir ibn Abdullah Al-Ansari, “I went to see (the Blessed Lady) Fatima (s). There was a tablet in front of her in which there were the names of the Trustees. There were twelve names - the last one of which is the Riser. Three of them were Muhammad (s) and four of them were Ali (s).”
